# LAMMPS input script for bulk Al energy calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al_structure.data

# Replicate 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

compute pe all pe/atom
compute eatoms all reduce sum c_pe

# Thermo output
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol c_eatoms

# Energy minimization

variable natoms equal "count(all)"
variable ecoh equal "c_eatoms"
variable ecohperatom equal "c_eatoms/v_natoms"

print "BULK ENERGY: ${ecoh}"

# LAMMPS input script for slab Al energy calculation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
